messages.content:
Risk: Confidential data in prompt
Description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
Concern: If not properly developed to secure confidential data, the model might reveal confidential information or IP in the generated output. Additionally, end users' confidential information might be unintentionally collected and stored.
Policy: Executive Compensation

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/LoansGeneral/LoansRegulatory/DataProtectionRequirement: data protection requirement — Requirements defining how data about individuals is held. Example is the EU DA directive and laws, which make the data the property of the individual that data is about. Covers - what information i sheld - who information can be divulged to. - the individual's rights in respect of that information Privacy regulations cover most of this. EU defines "Personal Data" and "Sensitive Personal Data". For credit reference agencies the latter would be covered. More detail about whether they can divulge facts which are not subject to formal judgements etc. [found by 5/9 queries]
  Siblings: notification obligation, delivery obligation, securities restriction
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/SecuritiesIssuance/IssuanceProcess/RegistrationInformation: registration information — Information relating to the registration of a registered security. [found by 5/9 queries]
  Siblings: debt issuance process information, issue subscription information, underwriting process details
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Documents/Notice: notice — announcement, communication, intimation, or advance warning of something, usually, but not necessarily, to allow preparations to be made [found by 7/9 queries]
  Siblings: indication of interest, publication, reference document
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/ContextualIdentifiers/ContextualIdentificationScheme: contextual identification scheme — identification scheme that applies within one or more contexts [found by 7/9 queries]
  Siblings: driver's license identification scheme, tax identification scheme, national identification number scheme
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00002011: Warning Message — A Message that describes a possible or impending threat. [found by 6/9 queries]
  Siblings: Notification Message, Email Message
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/ContextualDesignators/Context: context — situation or frame of reference in which something applies, exists, happens, or is used and that helps to illustrate or explain it [from restriction: isApplicableIn on ContextualIdentificationScheme]

axes.rationale: This class represents the specific types of sensitive or protected information (like personal or sensitive personal data) that are at risk of being leaked when included in a prompt. It defines the nature of the 'what' in the risk.

The risk depends heavily on the context in which the prompt is used (e.g., a professional setting vs. a personal one) and the frame of reference for the data being processed, which determines whether the data is considered confidential.
